newsitem.title: USA: Pace says Horizon unit signs for systems.
newsitem.headline: Pace says Horizon unit signs for systems.

text.p: Pace Health Management Systems Inc said it signed an agreement to provide its Care Management System to eight more rehabilitation hospitals run by Continental Medical Systems, a unit of Horizon/CMS Healthcare Corp.
Pace contracted with Continental for a pilot system in 1994 at one rehabilitation hospital.
As a result of that successful pilot experience, Continental signed an agreement and began installing 19 additional hospitals, Pace said.

"After further evaluating the benefits of the CMS and the speed with which hospitals were being implemented -- two hospitals every seven weeks -- Continental signed another agreement to install eight additional hospitals, bringing the total number of contracted facilities to 28," Pace said.
Pace sells healthcare data management software.
